# Graph operations · time

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### time.toFrames



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `time` | `seconds` | Required | seconds · {"finite":true} |
| Input | `fps` | `frameRate` | Required | frames/second · Positive rate or integer numerator/denominator, for example 30000/1001. · {"min":0.001,"max":1000,"accepts":["number","numerator/denominator record"]} |
| Input | `rounding` | `string` | `"floor"` | {"choices":["floor","ceil","nearest","exact"]} |
| Output | `value` | `frames` | — | frames · {"integer":true,"signed":true} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#convert-coordinates-time-and-colour-explicitly)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe time.toFrames --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
